ModMetaData.name: Epona Instruments Renew (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Outremer; recreation port by nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
Three carried instruments: great highland bagpipes, uilleann pipes and accordion.
Prepared locally; not published. Source rights remain with the original authors. No settings or custom MainButton. Enable this mod when upgrading from the former Joy Preservation collection; identifiers are preserved, but saves are not yet validated in game.
